I was lucky to get one FISP coupon for NPK fertilizer this season, so I will put two-thirds of that bag on this maize plot because it is my main field and I need it to feed my family. I will also spread the goat manure I collected there since it is my own land, and I will plant the hybrid seed they gave us because my brother used it last year and his cobs were big. My wife and children will weed and harvest it by hand — I have no cash to hire anyone or buy chemicals for such a small plot.
